sense.text:
“For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” The things written in the scriptures concerning our forefathers, and the mistakes they made, were written for us to learn from, not for us to repeat.

Some camps say Judah went and paid for a prostitute, so it is okay to buy prostitutes; some say Samson used to deal with hoes, so it is okay for us; some go to Solomon, one of the wisest men that ever walked this earth, and say he dealt with heathen women and concubines, so we can deal with white women and different women. No. Those are examples of what not to do. The mistakes our forefathers made were written for our learning, so that we do not do them.

That is the wisdom for the week: weak people notice other people's mistakes and laugh; strong people notice other people's mistakes and learn. When a brother falls or makes a mistake, don't laugh at him and don't be happy about it. Learn from your own mistakes, from the mistakes others make, and from the mistakes of our forefathers, and don't repeat them.

precepts.why:
“If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near”. That is where we are: we are living in the lands of our enemies today.

“Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives”: we must bethink ourselves, and to bethink yourself is to remember who you are. Then “and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness”. “And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies”: we must return unto God with all our heart and with all our soul, here in the land of our enemies.

What are they doing there? They are acknowledging their own sins, and they are acknowledging the sins of their fathers also. The Bible says we have to bethink ourselves and say that we sinned and our forefathers sinned. Why? Because we have to learn from the mistakes of our forefathers. That is why we acknowledge the sins we make and the sins our forefathers made: so that what was written aforetime is for our learning, and we do not repeat it.

sense.text:
“My son, if thou wilt, thou shalt be taught”: if you brothers will, you are going to be taught. “and if thou wilt apply thy mind, thou shalt be prudent.”

This goes with the wisdom for the week: weak people envy people ahead of them; strong people study people ahead of them. If you know somebody strong, somebody with understanding, somebody ahead of you, don't envy them. Study them. And you are not studying them to take them down; you are studying them to learn from them. That goes for the sisters too.

“If thou love to hear, thou shalt receive understanding: and if thou bow thine ear, thou shalt be wise”. If you bow your ears, you are going to be wise: meaning you listen. You listen, you study the person ahead of you, and you become wise.
“Stand in the multitude of the elders; and cleave unto him that is wise.” You watch the elders and you study the elders, and the reason you do it is to learn from the elders.

“Be willing to hear every godly discourse”. You must be willing to hear every godly discourse: what the Bishops are going over, the scripture they are breaking down. “and let not the parables of understanding escape thee”: when that discourse takes place, don't let the understanding leave you.

“And if thou seest a man of understanding, get thee betimes unto him, and let thy foot wear the steps of his door.” That goes right back to the wisdom for the week: when you see somebody ahead of you, somebody with understanding, make sure you study that person. Go to that person and learn from him, and don't envy him.

“Let thy mind be upon the ordinances of the Lord, and meditate continually in his commandments”. So the wisdom for the week is this: learn from your mistakes and from the mistakes of others, and if you see somebody of understanding, study that person and learn from that person. Don't envy that person.

White supremacy is not the KKK. The Ku Klux Klan was formed to terrorize people in support of white supremacy, but white supremacy was around long before the Klan. Here is what white supremacy really is.

“Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people”. That was the first form of democracy: everyone should be one people. Democracy teaches that everybody is equal. But is everybody really equal? Does democracy teach equality? No.
“And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.” All the heathen left their own laws and customs.

“Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion”. Everybody left their laws and their customs and followed whose laws and customs? The Greeks'. So who was really the head? The Greeks: white people. Under Antiochus they said let us all be one people, and they were all one people under him. Meaning you had to follow his religion, his politics, his customs. That is what democracy is.

It is the same thing in America. The white man came and said let us all be one people, and everybody had to follow the white man's religion, the Greek religion.

“To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.” They were trying to make the Israelites forget the laws and change all our customs. It is the same thing Daniel 7 speaks of, that he will think to change times and laws; that is what they were trying to do under the Greeks.

“And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.” If democracy is about equal rights, peace and equality, why would they kill you if you don't want to follow it? That shows it was never about peace, never about justice, never about freedom. Those of us that did not follow the Greek religion, Antiochus' religion, and did not conform to his democracy, were put to death.

So democracy under the Greeks was the beginning of white supremacy, the beginning of white people ruling the earth; read further and it tells you evil multiplied on the earth when the Greeks came into power. What they were pushing is that everybody had to conform to their religion and their customs and follow them. There is no such thing as equality: everybody else to the bottom and the Greeks to the top. That is democracy, that is what America is pushing, and that is white supremacy. Democracy is white supremacy: the nations to the bottom and the white man to the top, ruling.

Supremacy means the state of having the highest power, authority or status above everyone and everything else. White supremacy is white people having power, authority and status above everyone else, and that is how it is on the earth today. It is not just people with sheets in America. It is white people all over the world, all the European nations, ruling Africa, ruling India, ruling this whole planet and taking resources from all the nations. It is the fourth beast ruling this earth.

precepts.why:
This is what the white man did when he was ruling back in the time of the Greeks: “And laid open the book of the law, wherein the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.” The heathen tried to paint their likeness and their images inside the book of the law.

That was the first thing the white man did when he came into power: he said, we need to change history. It goes with 1 Maccabees 1:49, “To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.” White supremacy runs so deep that we can hardly get to the root of it.

That root is the whole white power structure: the eugenics tree with its biology, genealogy, archaeology, genetics, politics, economics, education, sociology, religion, medicine. These are the things white supremacy uses to control and destroy everybody else, and they are how Esau keeps himself supreme on the earth. It is not people running around with sheets over their heads alone; it is Netanyahu, Trump and the people behind them, Macron, Putin, the whole white power structure ruling the earth.

sense.text:
To be racist means you love your race and you put your race above all other races. The Chinese love their race, their people and their God and put them above everyone else; the Arabs do the same; white people do the same. Everybody wants their race on top. White people are racist: they love their race and their people, and there is nothing wrong with that. The problem is you blacks want them to love you the same way.

So see what Christ said: “Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying, Master, which is the great commandment in the law?”
“Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.” Love your God: not everybody else's god, your God, with all your heart, soul and mind.
“This is the first and great commandment.”

“And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.” To love your neighbour is talking about your race, your brother. So the two greatest commandments are to love your race and your God.

The Chinese apply it, the white man applies it, but we don't apply it amongst each other. We apply it to the white race instead, like Candace Owens, a black American calling herself a nationalist and pledging allegiance to the white race. We must have racial identity. We must love our God and we must love our people. Is it hateful to say I love my people, I want my people to be better, I want my communities clean, I want my people to get their own land and live amongst themselves? No. That is what racist really means. We are the ones that do not love our people and do not love our God: we worship a white god, another man's god.

But there is a different form of racism that white people deal with. Their racism is supremacy. They control the power structure, the educational system, the law, the judicial system, and they use that power and authority to oppress and destroy the so-called blacks and Hispanics worldwide. If I say I love my people, I cannot stop a white person from getting a job or affect a white community; we don't have that power. For the white man, racism and supremacy go hand in hand, because he uses both to oppress our people.

The number one tool used to put the inferiority complex on our people is the white Jesus, pushed through education and through religion. Idolatry is the tool the white man uses to make us inferior and submissive to him.

“For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication, and the invention of them the corruption of life.” Idols are the corruption of life.

“Whom men could not honour in presence, because they dwelt far off, they took the counterfeit of his visage from far, and made an express image of a king whom they honoured”. In history there were kings that set up images for people to honour them, and it is the same thing the white man did today.

“to the end that by this their forwardness they might flatter him that was absent, as if he were present.” As if the white man were right there. That is why people in the camp move like the white man is standing right there about to do something when they hear that the white man is the devil. That is the mindset, the spell of Christianity: Christianity is the tool they use to teach us an inferior complex.

That is why people hear that only Israel will make it to the kingdom and ask, what about the white man? Never what about the Chinese or the Arabs. That is Stockholm syndrome, the mentality of white supremacy: placing more value on the feelings of white people, getting up to give a white man your seat, calling him boss. That is slave talk. Our people have been destroyed by it, and not just us: all nations worship the white man.

This is white supremacy in the scriptures. “Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful”. The fourth beast is the fourth kingdom to rise up and rule this earth, the fourth and the last kingdom, and that is the one we are living in. It began with Rome, then Europe and America: the Caucasian race, white people.

“whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet”. That is what the white man did to everyone. All nations were colonized by the white man: China, India, the whole of Africa, Pakistan, all the Arab countries. Britain did it, Spain did it. Devour, break in pieces, and stamp all nations under his feet. That is white supremacy, the white man ruling and everybody below him, and it is nothing new.

“And of the ten horns that were in his head”: the ten horns are Europe. “and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell”: that is America that came up, and the three that fell are Britain, France and Spain.

“even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things”: those very great things are the blasphemies and lies the white man is pushing on this earth. “whose look was more stout than his fellows”, because America came with all types of technology.

“I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them”. That same horn is part of the fourth beast, and it made war with the Israelites. That is called slavery and colonialism. They made war with us and prevailed against us. What is this? It is racism; it is white supremacy.

“Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High”. The saints are us, the 12 tribes of Israel, and judgment will be given to the Israelites. “and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom”: we are going to possess this kingdom.

“Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth”: the so-called Rome, and America and Europe are an extension of Rome, the toes. The fourth kingdom is the white race, white supremacy, that racist white power structure that is ruling and oppressing everybody on the earth today.

“which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth”. What is that called? White supremacy, white power. Our minds think small, but it is not just America: Esau is ruling the whole earth, and white power is established all over it. France still makes fourteen African countries use its CFA franc and keep half their foreign reserves in the French treasury. It is France, Belgium, Spain, all of them. Think on an international level: that global white power structure is now being challenged by China and by Iran.

“and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.” To break it in pieces means to divide up the earth. That is what the Berlin Conference was about: they broke it in pieces and divided the land.

“And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise”: the ten nations of Europe. “and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.”

“And he shall speak great words against the most High”: they speak against the Most High. “and shall wear out the saints of the most High”: they wore out the saints, the sons of God, in slavery, wore us out to where we no longer know who we are, and we call ourselves all these different titles and names.

“and think to change times and laws”. He changed God's laws; he changed the Sabbath day. Why does it say think? Because even though he thinks it, we are going to reverse it: we are going to bring out the truth and bring it back around.

precepts.why:
“And I beheld, and, lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice unto the eagle, and said, Hear thou, I will talk with thee, and the Highest shall say unto thee, Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world”. This is the fourth beast, and the fourth beast is called the eagle. Whose symbol is the eagle? America, Esau. This is the white superpower ruling the earth in the last days. The fourth beast is white supremacy, white people ruling this earth.

“whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them”. God allowed the white man to rule in his world, and the end of the white man's time will come through them, because they created a lot of weapons and they will use them on each other.

“And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past”: the white man came and overcame all the kingdoms before him, ancient Babylon, the Persians. “and had power over the world”: that is white power. Remember the first and second Opium Wars, when Britain went to war to force China to buy drugs from them; they were the first drug dealers.

“with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression”. That is racism right there. We are reading about white supremacy and their racism: they rule with oppression. It is what was done to us in slavery, the lynchings and hangings in Mississippi today, the police shooting us down in the streets, and all the coups and killings taking place in Nigeria and all these countries. The oppression is all over the world, not just in America.

“and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.” With deceit, because he acts like a righteous, god-fearing people, a Christian nation that believes in Christ. “For the earth hast thou not judged with truth.” He is the one on top, the one in power, but he did not judge the earth in truth. “For thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable, thou hast loved liars”. He hurt the peaceable: the Iranians were trying to make peace with them, and they bombed them and killed their leader.

sense.text: This is how they retain that white power. “And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.”

“And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.” Those three unclean spirits are politics, economics, and religion, which is Christianity.

They are the building blocks of this system, and they are part of the eugenics tree. That is the white power structure: they use their economics to control the world, which is the IMF and the US dollar; they use their religion, Christianity and Judaism, to control the world; and they use their politics and policies to control the world. That is white power, white supremacy.

“For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles”: these three unclean spirits are preparing the kings of the earth for war. This week they said they would put sanctions on any nation that does business with Iran: that is economics. These three things are what will make the kings of the earth get angry and rise up and fight against America.

You cannot be a revolutionary trying to overthrow a system while you support it and are part of it. This is what God says we have to do concerning this racist white supremacy system: the educational system that teaches us lies, the food they feed us that is garbage.

“And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people”. God says for us to come out of her. “that ye be not partakers of her sins”: her sins are the policies, and it is all white supremacy: Jesus Christ being white, Easter, Christmas, all these things are white supremacy. “and that ye receive not of her plagues”: if you don't come out, you are going to receive of her plagues.

White supremacy is embedded in every day of our lives, and many of us are still under it without knowing it, because we are part of their system: we send our kids to their schools, we eat their food, we trust in the system they set up, and we measure happiness by what the white man told us happiness is, his holidays and his American dream. That is partaking of her sins, and that is why God says come out of her.

precepts.why:
“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord”. God says let us come out from amongst them and separate ourselves. That is the only way to fight against this system. You can't be part of the system and try to come up with the solution; we have to start separating, starting with that white supremacy way of thinking.

To separate means teach your own kids. You cannot be against white supremacy and send your children to public school: the public school was set up by white supremacists to brainwash our people, teaching that Christopher Columbus discovered America, just as the boarding schools were first used on the North American Indians, and church and school went hand in hand in the colonized countries. Education is needed, but we need our own teachers and our own schools.

It also means coming out of their American dream: take out a thirty-year mortgage and pay three times what the house is worth, and if you lose your job you lose it. Before 1965 they never gave black people loans and we never used their banks; we worked together amongst ourselves and built our own houses. That mortgage was a trap set up to keep us in debt, a false dream and a false form of happiness that white supremacy set up for us.

“and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you”. Don't touch the unclean thing, pledging allegiance to the white man through his unclean things, like celebrating Independence Day. That is when the Lord will receive us.

sense.text:
A lot of us think white people changed after 1965, that they love us now and are not supremacists anymore. “And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you”.

Who is ruling over us? They that hate us. White supremacy is ruling over the 12 tribes of Israel, and they hate us.

precepts.why:
This is what the Bible says they are going to do. “And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.” That is when they came conquering: they cause confusion and take lands, countries and resources.

“Then shall his mind change”. After he has raped and stolen and murdered, the white man says, I've got to change, I've got to make things look a little more kosher; I can't just be killing millions of people like that anymore, we are the rulers of the earth. So in 1965 they gave the slaves civil rights and went around the world acting as Christians, God-fearing people. Our people thought they changed, but did white people really change? No, they have not changed.

“and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.” That is what you see happening today. He does it in the name of white Jesus. Jake Lang says he is a Christian and protests against the Muslims in the name of Jesus, and he and all these Christian white nationalists are offending a lot of people; that is the one Spider-Man punched in Minneapolis. He may well be working for the Mossad or the government, stirring up civil unrest and chaos to get white people riled up against the Muslims; if a black person did what he does, they would have locked him away. And in Mississippi a new set of white people, the Patriot Front, are rising up with masks on their faces. White people have not changed.

sense.text: The Patriot Front said on Independence Day that the future belongs to the men with iron in their blood and patriotism in their heart. What is that iron? “And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.”

“And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron”. The fourth kingdom is white supremacy, the white race, the Edomite race ruling the earth. “forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.” That iron is white people: the fourth beast, the Caucasian race.

“And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided”. That is what we see going on in Europe and America: they are divided, because after 1945 and 1965 they let in people from all the countries they colonized, from the Caribbean islands and India, to rebuild London and to chase the American dream, and America became the great melting pot. Now the iron is rising up and saying, get out of our country.

“but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron”: the strength of white people, their military and their technology.

“And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.” God says this last kingdom is broken and there is nothing you can do to fix it, because you mixed nations in your kingdom.

“And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another”. The iron, white people, have mingled themselves, but they are not going to cleave; everybody is not going to get along. Why? “even as iron is not mixed with clay.” White people hate everybody. They are racist and they don't want to mix with East Indians or with anyone. That is why this kingdom is partly strong and partly broken.

“And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom”. That is the time we are living in right now. So what God said we have to do is separate, and when we separate, set up a kingdom within a kingdom. You cannot be a revolutionary and support white supremacy and stay in its system while you talk about fighting it. When God says separate, he is saying create your own system; those of you that have the skills, let's work together and do it.

The white supremacy kingdom, that white power structure, is ruling the earth today, and God says he will set up another power structure within that power structure: the kingdom of heaven that shall never be destroyed. That is us and what you see us doing.

This is what is going to happen in America. “Cut off the sower from Babylon”: who is farming in Babylon? Not white people. The sower is the slaves in Babylon, the Israelites, the Northern Kingdom and the Haitians. We are the servants here. “and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest”: him that is reaping.

“for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people”. What is the oppressing sword that is rising up? The ICE agents, ICE becoming federalized, the riots all over America. That oppressing sword is the white man. The iron is rising up and saying we don't want you negroes, you Muslims, or any of you amongst us anymore. You thought white people changed? They did not change; they have been hiding their nature for years.

precepts.why: “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword”. The wicked is God's sword. Who is the wicked? Esau, Edom, white supremacy. They are the oppressing sword of Jeremiah 50:16 that is going to rise up against our people. That is why the scripture says that in our affliction we shall seek God early.

sense.text: Now black supremacy: Israelite supremacy, 12 tribe supremacy, what God prophesied is going to happen if we endure and keep his commandments. “And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations”. God is going to give us power over the nations. That is black power, black sovereignty, black supremacy. When the Lord returns he will give us power over all the nations on the earth. As white supremacy is taking place on the earth today, there will be Israelite supremacy: we will be the ones ruling and making laws on this earth. Black people are going to rule the earth, and white people can't fathom that.

“And he shall rule them with a rod of iron”: we are going to rule the nations with a rod of iron. That is Israelite supremacy. “as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers”: we are going to break them to shivers.

precepts.why: “And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.” Solomon reigned over all kingdoms. That was Israelite supremacy, and that is how we are going to be again on the earth when God gives us power over the nations.

sense.text:
This is Israelite supremacy, Israelite sovereignty, Israelite power. “And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains”. We are going to be established on top of all nations, the most powerful nation on this earth. That is what we are working for.

White people want to be racist? Let them be racist: you love your race and your people, and I will love my race and my people. The Chinese want to rule the earth, Iran wants to become a world superpower; everybody is racing for dominion, and negroes are asleep talking about equality. There is no such thing as equality. Somebody has to be at the top and somebody at the bottom; somebody has to serve and somebody has to rule. Don't be tricked and fooled.

“and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.” When Christ returns in the last days, the Lord's kingdom is going to be established above all kingdoms, and all nations shall flow unto it.

“And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law”. The law is going to go forth from Zion because that is where the Lord will be, the way the law now comes forth from Washington, DC and goes throughout the earth. “and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.”

“And he shall judge among the nations”: we are going to judge amongst the nations. “and shall rebuke many people”: many nations are going to be rebuked and broken, as we read in Revelation 2:26-27. “and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks”: they are going to become servants.

“nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.” When we rule this earth, that is when nation will not rise up against nation. That is when there will be peace in the Middle East, no more wars and no more suffering: when Christ and the Israelites have world dominion. That is Israelite supremacy.

So white supremacy is not just the KKK with sheets over their heads. It is the fourth beast ruling this whole earth, the white establishments set up throughout the earth, the IMF and SWIFT, their religion, their economics, their education that teaches us lies. To combat it, God says we have to separate, come out from amongst them, and establish the kingdom of God within their kingdom.
